about: Numbers that join the two games. VS units are Vampire Survivors world units (its camera shows about 2 x C_CamOrtho of them top to bottom); ROUNDS units are ROUNDS world units (its own screen is 40 tall). A fresh ROUNDS gun: 55 damage, 0.3 s between shots, 3 ammo, about 2 s reload. Each row becomes a constant in Tuning (src/Shared/Generated/Tuning.g.cs).

rows.why: the VS camera's half height shown as this many ROUNDS units: the ROUNDS blob is about 5% of the screen tall, like VS's own characters (ROUNDS's own screen is 20)
a fresh 55-damage bullet does 16.5, like VS's starting weapons (Magic Wand 10, Whip 10, Knife 6.5) a little stronger since one gun replaces six weapon slots
percent-of-health cards would one-shot bosses; a flat amount instead (scaled by damageScale downstream as in Roundhead)
VS lands about five enemy touches a second on a surrounded character; one ROUNDS gun clears a horde slower than VS's starting weapons, so a touch takes half its VS damage from ROUNDS's 100 health
Floor Chicken (+30) and regen heal ROUNDS's health one to one
at most one VS hit per seat this often reaches ROUNDS (about 2.5 a second when surrounded; VS paces its own hits too)
a VS hit taken during the ROUNDS block reaches ROUNDS as a blocked hit at most this often
auto-aim picks the nearest enemy within the screen (a little past its edge); none in range = the gun rests
after the mouse moves (or the right stick tilts) it aims for this long, then auto-aim takes over again

Orange and Blue start every life with this much health instead of ROUNDS's 100: ROUNDS cards make a guy strong much faster than VS's items make a VS hero (0.3.0 balance), so he starts more fragile; health cards multiply it as in ROUNDS

a treasure chest is a ROUNDS card pick only when the last chest card was at least this long ago on VS's run clock; the others give their gold alone (bosses and elites drop chests in bunches: ten chest cards in ten minutes made the guys too strong too soon, 0.3.0)
